title: Palindrome Check
statementMd:
A palindrome reads the same forwards and backwards. Ignoring upper/lower case, print `Yes` if the word is a palindrome, otherwise `No`.

**Input**
One word (letters only, 1–1000 characters).

**Output**
`Yes` or `No`.
hints: Convert to one case first: s.toLowerCase().
Compare s.charAt(i) with s.charAt(length - 1 - i), moving inwards from both ends.
